tooltip.jaymospowers.rig.octo.arms: Four jointed arms folded down the spine: plate and pistons, the Tinkerer's copy of a symbiote's tendrils
tooltip.jaymospowers.rig.octo.menu: Rig menu (Sneak + J): Arms Out, then grab, skewer, pinwheel, vault, anchor, watch, walk, and jab, cross, blast. Needs only this Core
gui.jaymospowers.rig_menu.octo_vault: Arm Vault (again in the air: dive)
message.jaymospowers.rig_octo.in: The arms fold down the spine
message.jaymospowers.rig_octo.watch_low: Charge low: the arms stand down
message.jaymospowers.rig_octo.cant_build: Only a Tinkerer or a web slinger can read the Octo Core's drawings
rig.jaymospowers.mind.loyal.octo_none: Nothing there the arms can take.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.dry.octo_none: Four arms, and nothing to hold.
talk.jaymospowers.tinkerer.octo.1: "The arms? Watched a fellow with one of those black suits pull a cart out of a ditch without touching it. Ropes of the stuff, out of his back! Wonderful. Disgusting. I wanted it without the eating, so: plate, pistons, four joints a side. A Tinkerer can follow the drawing. So can any of you web folk, oddly. You lot seem to know what a tendril wants."
talk.jaymospowers.tinkerer.octo.2: "Four arms, not two. Two to hold, two to stand on. The suit thing grows as many as it likes, but I have to bolt mine on, and four is what a spine will carry. Build it at a forge, if you have the salvage. Mind your fingers in the elbows."
